title: sign(): implement multi-signer SignedData construction
description: Loop over all keys: compute per-signer digest+attrs+signature, build one SignerInfo per key. Accumulate all DigestAlgorithmIdentifiers and all Certificates into the SignedData bag. SignedData.version: V3 if any SignerInfo uses SubjectKeyIdentifier, V1 if all use IssuerAndSerialNumber (RFC 5652 §5.1). micalg param: comma-separated list of unique digest algorithm names (RFC 5751 §3.4.3.2), deduped and sorted.
